title: North Winston Villa | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked along the scenic park side of 30A, this beautifully designed coastal retreat blends timeless elegance with relaxed luxury. The five-bedroom, four-and-a-half-bath home offers a spacious and thoughtfully crafted layout, featuring an open-concept living area, a gourmet kitchen with premium appliances, and stylish interiors filled with warm textures and modern coastal accents. A cozy gas fireplace and inviting gathering spaces create the perfect setting for family time, while the entire third floor is dedicated to a stunning primary suite complete with vaulted ceilings, a private balcony, a fireplace, and a spa-inspired bathroom with a soaking tub and glass walk-in shower. Outside, a private courtyard oasis invites relaxation with a heated pool, sun loungers, outdoor dining area, and grilling station, all surrounded by lush landscaping and a fenced backyard. The charming carriage house adds extra flexibility with its own queen suite, kitchenette, living area, and balcony, ideal for additional family or friends. Located just 0.3 miles from the beach and a short walk or bike ride to the shops and dining of Rosemary Beach, the home offers effortless access to the best of 30A while providing a serene and luxurious escape designed for unforgettable coastal stays.

Features: Outdoor Heated pool Pool Outdoor grill
Guests assume all risk for use of pools
